responsible.title: Responsible gambling
responsible.subtitle: The risks, and the controls that keep betting inside limits you choose.
responsible.intro: Betting should stay entertainment. This page explains what the risk actually is and what tools would let you set your own boundaries. In this demonstration build the tools are simulated, but their behaviour and their delays are the ones a licensed operator would have to implement.
responsible.age.title: Strictly for adults
responsible.age.body: Betting is for people aged 18 and over. A real operator must confirm your identity and your age through an accredited provider before you can deposit or place a bet. This demonstration verifies nothing and no one.
responsible.risk.title: Betting carries real risk
responsible.risk.body: Over time the odds always favour the operator. Most people who bet lose money, and losses grow fastest when someone tries to win them back. Never stake an amount you are not prepared to lose entirely.
responsible.risk.signs.title: Warning signs
responsible.risk.signs.1: You keep betting to win back what you have lost.
responsible.risk.signs.2: You bet more, or more often, than you meant to.
responsible.risk.signs.3: You borrow money, or sell something, to keep betting.
responsible.risk.signs.4: You hide how much you bet from your family or friends.
responsible.risk.signs.5: Betting is affecting your work, your studies or your sleep.
responsible.risk.signs.6: You bet to escape stress, boredom or low mood.
responsible.tools.title: Your controls
responsible.tools.intro: Set your boundaries before you need them. Lowering a limit is immediate; raising one is deliberately slow.
responsible.limits.deposit.title: Deposit limit
responsible.limits.deposit.body: Caps how much you can add to your balance over a chosen period.
responsible.limits.stake.title: Stake limit
responsible.limits.stake.body: Caps the total you can stake across all of your bets in a period.
responsible.limits.loss.title: Loss limit
responsible.limits.loss.body: Blocks further betting once your net losses reach the amount you set.
responsible.limits.session.title: Session limit
responsible.limits.session.body: Ends your session automatically after the time you choose.
responsible.limits.singleBet.title: Single bet limit
responsible.limits.singleBet.body: Caps the stake allowed on any one bet, however it is placed.
responsible.limits.decreaseImmediate: A lower limit applies the moment you save it.
responsible.limits.increaseDelayed: A higher limit only takes effect {hours} hours after you request it. You can cancel the change at any point before then.
responsible.cooling.title: Take a break
responsible.cooling.body: A cooling-off period locks betting and deposits for a short while. You can still sign in to see your history, and access returns on its own when the period ends.
responsible.selfExclusion.title: Self-exclusion
responsible.selfExclusion.body: Self-exclusion closes betting for a long, fixed period. With a licensed operator it is also filed with the national self-exclusion register, so it holds across every operator covered by that register.
responsible.selfExclusion.warning: Self-exclusion cannot be reversed early. Once it starts it runs to the end of the period you chose — no request, appeal or message to support will shorten it.
responsible.realityCheck.title: Reality check
responsible.realityCheck.body: A reminder interrupts you at a fixed interval to show how long you have been playing and where you stand. It is on by default: you can change the interval, not switch the reminder off.
responsible.support.title: Getting help
responsible.support.body: If betting stops feeling like a choice, talk to someone. A doctor, a psychologist or a specialist addiction service can help, and telling family early makes the rest easier.
responsible.helplinePlaceholder: No helpline number is shown here. A national gambling helpline number will be published on this page as soon as a licensed operator supplies the official one — an unverified number will never be displayed.
responsible.demoNote: Limits and breaks you set here are stored on your account and enforced by the server on every bet.
responsible.selfAssessment.title: Self-assessment
responsible.selfAssessment.body: A short set of questions will tell you more than a gut feeling does. Answer honestly — the result is only worth anything if you do.
responsible.launchGate.title: What real operation would require
responsible.launchGate.body: SportGo is a demonstration and is not licensed to offer gambling. Every item below would have to be in place, verified and audited before a single real bet could be accepted.
responsible.launchGate.gambling_licence: Gambling licence from the competent authority
responsible.launchGate.sanctions_pep_scr: Sanctions and politically exposed person screening
responsible.launchGate.national_self_exc: Connection to the national self-exclusion register
responsible.launchGate.player_funds_segr: Player funds held separately from company funds
responsible.launchGate.advertising_and_p: Legal review of advertising and promotions
responsible.launchGate.data_protection_r: Registration with the data protection authority
responsible.validation.acknowledgeRequir: You must acknowledge this before continuing
responsible.validation.confirmationRequi: Type the confirmation exactly as shown
responsible.validation.valuePrecision: Limits use at most two decimals
responsible.selfExclusion.acknowledge: I understand that this cannot be reversed before it ends
responsible.error.selfExcluded: You are on a break and cannot bet or play right now
responsible.launchGate.casino_licence_cl: A licence covering casino games specifically — a sports-betting permission does not extend to them
responsible.launchGate.certified_rng_and: RNG and every game certified by an accredited testing laboratory, with the reported RTP independently verified
responsible.signInTitle: Sign in to use these tools
responsible.signInBody: Limits and breaks are attached to your account.
responsible.active.title: A break is active
responsible.active.note: You cannot bet or play while this is active. You can still sign in and withdraw. It cannot be ended early — not by you and not by an administrator.
responsible.exclusionStarted: Your break has started. You can still sign in and withdraw.
responsible.error.singleBetLimit: That bet is above your single-bet limit
responsible.error.stakeLimit: That bet would exceed your stake limit for this period
responsible.error.lossLimit: That bet could take you past your loss limit for this period
responsible.error.depositLimit: That deposit would exceed this player’s deposit limit
